$comment: Licences that pnpm licenses:check accepts. Source of truth: the allowlist in s7video-planning tickets/README.md, ADR-001 and ADR-003 (amendment 2: FTL, BSD-3-Clause-Open-MPI, MIT-Modern-Variant as MIT, and the FFmpeg helper's 'helper' allowances). Order matters: for a dual licence the check elects the first allowed option in this list (most permissive first).

devOnly.reason: Permissive, not OSI-approved. truncate-utf8-bytes only, in electron-builder's build chain; never shipped. S7V-005 audit: keep (dev). PO decision recorded as an ADR-003 amendment.

helper.reason: ADR-003: LGPL only as a dynamically linked library of the separate FFmpeg helper (FFmpeg, FriBidi), which the app runs as a subprocess; never linked into our code.
ADR-003 amendment 2: zimg only, shipped in the FFmpeg helper for HDR export (zscale). Any other WTFPL package still fails.
